status_legend.not_started: Accepted work with no implementation in progress.
status_legend.active: The single feature currently being implemented or verified.
status_legend.blocked: Work cannot proceed until its blocker and next trigger are satisfied.
status_legend.passing: Observable behavior is complete with durable evidence; this state is irreversible.

features.title: Initial repo harness simplification
features.user_visible_behavior: Repository instructions, state, environment, and verification have named owners instead of relying on chat history.

features.title: Canonical local harness contract
features.user_visible_behavior: A fresh session starts from a concise AGENTS.md, PROGRESS.md, and feature_list.json, receives deterministic local feedback, and cannot bypass semantic state or multidimensional file budgets.

features.title: Canonical shared enforcement gap
features.user_visible_behavior: All canonical harness checks run locally, while the owner-directed private pre-alpha policy intentionally provides no hosted CI enforcement.
features.blocker: The owner requires all hosted CI to remain absent, while the canonical harness-engineering package requires shared CI enforcement for applicable repository controls.
features.next_trigger: The owner authorizes shared enforcement or the project leaves the private pre-alpha phase and the no-CI decision is revisited.

features.title: Final canonical harness re-evaluation
features.user_visible_behavior: Developers receive a fully inventoried, evidence-bound harness disposition with all safely testable local behavior rerun from the current repository and a clean snapshot.

features.title: CLI-complete v0.5.0 release
features.user_visible_behavior: The CLI provides the complete technical, automation, recovery, and verification surface with secure defaults and stable documented contracts.

features.title: Apple container runtime and security hardening
features.user_visible_behavior: Task-scoped runs, provider egress, image lifecycle, and state and network cleanup preserve the documented Apple container boundary.

features.title: Multi-provider API-key credential broker
features.user_visible_behavior: Explicit Claude and Codex API-key broker values stay host-side and in memory; other supported agents use isolated in-container login state.

features.title: Easy isolated login
features.user_visible_behavior: Supported subscription logins run inside isolated agent state without mounting host credential stores.

features.title: Log sanitization and token handling hardening
features.user_visible_behavior: Stored or displayed output and diagnostics redact secrets, while isolated login credentials remain inside container state and broker values remain host-side and in memory.

features.title: Desktop launch and feedback
features.user_visible_behavior: The desktop app supports setup, folder choice, plan review, confirmed launch, readiness, sanitized status, and bounded output through typed Tauri commands.

features.title: Desktop stop run control
features.user_visible_behavior: The desktop app stops only a validated active RunHaven run and only after explicit confirmation.

features.title: Desktop kill and repair run control
features.user_visible_behavior: The desktop app hard-stops a validated active run or repairs a stale marker only after explicit confirmation.

features.title: Secret-free desktop diagnostics
features.user_visible_behavior: The desktop app exposes read-only provider and authentication metadata without secrets or workspace paths.

features.title: Explicit SSH-agent forwarding boundary
features.user_visible_behavior: The warned --ssh option forwards only the host SSH-agent socket to the non-root guest; it never mounts raw keys, and unusable private sockets fail safely.

features.title: CLI plus native GUI external testing readiness
features.user_visible_behavior: The CLI remains the complete technical surface and the native-feeling desktop GUI is the easy path for setup, launch, managed sessions, bounded interaction, diagnostics, support, and recovery.

features.title: Pre-release readiness
features.user_visible_behavior: A distributed build has current local verification, Apple container smokes, pins, documentation, signing, notarization, accessibility, and clean-Mac evidence.
features.blocker: Distribution lacks explicit maintainer authorization and the required paid Apple credentials and external evidence.
features.next_trigger: The maintainer explicitly requests a distribution pass and provides the required signing and notarization authority.

features.title: Terminal UI workspace integration
features.user_visible_behavior: The comprehensive TUI is an active RunHaven workspace unit with its exact pinned Codex graph isolated behind the TUI boundary; bare RunHaven invocation continues to use the CLI.
